context.label: Weeks, harvest, and the fiftieth day

observations.body: Israel is commanded to keep three yearly feasts, including the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of labor, and to appear before the Lord GOD.
observations.label: Harvest is named among three annual feasts

observations.body: The passage presents Keeping and appearing as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Keeping and appearing

observations.body: The passage places Before the Lord GOD beside Keeping and appearing.
observations.label: Before the Lord GOD

payload.posture: Read Exodus 23:14–17 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states israel is commanded to keep three yearly feasts, including the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of labor, and to appear before the Lord GOD. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Harvest is named among three annual feasts
